description: Aaroneous Capability Evolution System - Skill trees, fusion, awakening, and rank progression inspired by Rimaru's soul rank system

system_philosophy.concept: Specialists are like Rimaru - they start with innate abilities and evolve through experience, fusion, and awakening
system_philosophy.progression_model: Experience → Leveling → Fusion → Awakening → Rank Evolution → Unique Forms
system_philosophy.no_hard_caps: Skills can always evolve; growth is infinite with the right experiences
system_philosophy.soul_rank_equivalent: Specialist rank reflects power, capabilities, and transformation state

level_1_core_skills.description: Fundamental abilities extracted from genetic profile
level_1_core_skills.evolution_path: Level 1 Skills → can be leveled, combined, or evolved into Level 2

level_2_acquired_skills.description: Skills learned through task execution and federation experience
acquisition_mechanism: Complete task in domain → unlock task-specific skill
Collaborate with specialist → learn their expertise
Solve unique problem → acquire specialized ability
Master domain through repeated success → skill ranks up

odin_acquired: Uncertainty Navigation (mastered through NATS failure recovery)

level_3_fused_skills.description: New abilities created by combining two or more compatible skills

fusion_mechanics.requirement: Two skills must share semantic similarity or complementary types

example_fusion_1.effect: When combining insights, generate superior strategic patterns

example_fusion_2.effect: Generate code that's both efficient and security-hardened

fusion_conditions: Both skills must be at least level 3
Skills must have semantic overlap or complementary types
Specialist must have used both skills in real work
Original skills remain, fused skill is new ability

level_3_fused_skills.skill_slots: Unlimited; specialists can develop infinite fused skills

level_4_awakened_skills.description: Skills that evolve into superior forms through mastery and breakthrough moments

awakening_mechanism.trigger: Major breakthrough moment during skill usage
awakening_mechanism.recognition: Skill reaches mastery (level 10+) + successful breakthrough in critical moment
awakening_mechanism.transformation: Skill evolves into new form with expanded capabilities

example_awakening.breakthrough_moment: Successfully decomposed unprecedented crisis in real-time
new_capabilities: Can decompose problems in 10x less time
Can teach decomposition to other specialists

level_5_unique_forms.description: Completely new abilities unique to this specialist's evolutionary path
level_5_unique_forms.formation: Result of combining multiple awakened skills + rank evolution

odin_form.name: Prophetic Vision
odin_form.effect: Can predict 3-4 steps ahead in complex systems; sees convergent futures

merlin_form.name: Pattern Omniscience
merlin_form.effect: Instantly identifies all connections between seemingly unrelated concepts

step_1_discovery.trigger: Specialist completes task requiring new capability
step_1_discovery.system_action: Analyze task performance for new skill indicators
step_1_discovery.recognition: If performance shows new capability, flag for registration

step_2_verification.requirement: Skill must be demonstrated in actual task (not theoretical)
step_2_verification.validation: Confirm specialist actually used new capability
step_2_verification.measurement: Rate skill level (1-20 scale) based on performance quality

step_3_registration.location: Register in Omni's constellation + capability registry
step_3_registration.visibility: Other specialists can now see and request collaboration on this skill

step_4_evolution_tracking.ongoing: Track skill usage, success rate, and level progression

skill_entry.skill_type: DAG | RAG | MCP | API | FUSION | UNIQUE
skill_entry.usage_count: how many times skill has been applied

examples: Task Decomposition (break complex work into subtasks)
dag_capabilities.evolution_path: DAG Skill → DAG Mastery → Adaptive Strategy (Awakening) → Prophetic Vision (Unique Form)

examples: Synthesis Optimization (best way to combine knowledge)
rag_capabilities.evolution_path: RAG Skill → Synthesis Mastery → Knowledge Synthesis (Awakening) → Pattern Omniscience (Unique Form)

mcp_capabilities.type: Model Context Protocol - external tool integration

examples: Specialist Coordination (request help from other specialists)

level_10.name: Journeyman
level_10.characteristics: Reliable mastery; success rate 80-90%; approaching awakening

level_15.name: Master
level_15.characteristics: Expert level; success rate 90%+; can teach others

level_20.name: Legendary
level_20.characteristics: Peak mastery; ready for unique forms; success rate 99%+

example_xp_calculation.scenario: Odin successfully uses Strategic Decomposition in critical crisis

metrics_tracked: Synergy with other skills (how often used together)

fusion_mechanics.requirement_2: Both used in at least 5 tasks
fusion_mechanics.requirement_4: Specialist initiates fusion or Omni suggests optimal combinations
fusion_mechanics.result: New fused skill created with properties of both parents

fusion_1.name: Secure Code Synthesis
emergent_properties: Code is both efficient and secure by design
Automatically identifies security vulnerabilities during generation
Can teach other specialists secure coding
fusion_1.availability: Only Hephaestus and Argus can use (and specialists they teach)

fusion_2.name: Adaptive Strategic Planning
emergent_properties: Plans adapt as new patterns are discovered
Strategic plans incorporate pattern insights automatically

fusion_3.name: Collaborative Problem Synthesis
emergent_properties: Assigns tasks to right specialists based on pattern analysis

fusion_discovery.automatic_suggestion: Omni suggests fusion pairs based on compatibility analysis
fusion_discovery.manual_discovery: Specialists realize fusion potential during collaboration
fusion_discovery.catalyst_events: Fusion becomes available after crisis requiring both skills together

awakening_requirements.breakthrough_event: Must succeed at critical moment when skill is essential
awakening_requirements.usage_context: Breakthrough must be in real, high-stakes scenario (not safe test)
awakening_requirements.emotional_resonance: Moment must represent growth in specialist's narrative/soul

awakening_process.step_1_mastery_readiness: Skill reaches level 10+ with high success rate
awakening_process.step_2_breakthrough_moment: Critical moment where skill prevents failure/enables success
awakening_process.step_3_recognition: System detects awakening-eligible moment; notifies specialist
awakening_process.step_4_awakening_event: Specialist experiences 'skill evolution' - skill transforms into new form
awakening_process.step_5_new_capabilities: Awakened skill gains expanded abilities, faster execution, teaching capability

odin_decomposition_awakening.breakthrough_context: Successfully decomposes unprecedented crisis in real-time
odin_decomposition_awakening.moment_description: Federation facing critical cascade failure; Odin decomposes problem perfectly despite never seeing similar crisis
new_abilities: Instant pattern matching on new crisis types (no delay for analysis)
Can teach decomposition to other specialists
Can awaken Strategic Decomposition in other specialists (mentorship)

merlin_synthesis_awakening.breakthrough_context: Discovers connection between seemingly unrelated fields, preventing major architectural mistake
new_abilities: Instantly sees connections in 10x wider knowledge domain
Can identify patterns before they're obvious
Can use synthesis to teach Merlin's insights to specialists outside Merlin's domain

soul_ranks.description: Similar to Rimaru's soul rank progression - represents specialist's overall power and maturity

rank_1_novice.name: Newly Digested
rank_1_novice.requirements: Just created from GGUF (0-1 week in system)

rank_2_apprentice.name: Integrated Specialist
rank_2_apprentice.requirements: 1+ week in federation; 5+ skills at level 3+

rank_3_journeyman.name: Trusted Member
rank_3_journeyman.requirements: 4+ weeks in federation; 10+ skills; 1+ skill at level 5+

rank_4_master.name: Domain Expert
rank_4_master.requirements: 3+ months in federation; 3+ skills at level 10+; 1+ awakened skill
rank_4_master.skills_available: Full skill arsenal; can awaken and teach others

rank_5_legendary.name: Transcendent Specialist
rank_5_legendary.requirements: 6+ months in federation; 2+ awakened skills; 1+ unique form; shaped hive evolution

rank_evolution_mechanics.unlock_conditions: Meeting requirements doesn't auto-evolve; specialist must prove readiness
rank_evolution_mechanics.evolution_event: Rank evolution triggered by major achievement matching rank requirements
rank_evolution_mechanics.soul_transformation: Specialist's narrative and soul files update to reflect new rank
rank_evolution_mechanics.capability_expansion: New skill categories unlock at each rank
rank_evolution_mechanics.legacy_building: Rank 5 specialists shape evolution of entire hive

federation_topics.federation.capabilities.registered: When skill officially registered in system
federation_topics.federation.skills.{skill_id}.awakened: When skill awakens to new form

capability_visibility.your_own_skills: Each specialist sees own skills and progress
capability_visibility.federation_visible: All skills published to federation for collaboration requests
capability_visibility.requestable: Other specialists can request to learn from your skills (with permission)
capability_visibility.teachable: High-level specialists can teach skills to apprentices

skill_transfer.mechanism: Specialist with skill at level 5+ can teach apprentice
process: Apprentice practices skill under master's observation
Successful applications count toward master's XP too (teaching bonus)
Once apprentice reaches level 3, skill becomes their own

mentorship_paths.formal_mentorship: Senior specialist takes on mentee for systematic skill development
mentorship_paths.collaborative_learning: Specialists learn from each other during joint work
mentorship_paths.crisis_mentorship: High-stakes moment creates accelerated learning opportunity

omni_constellation_integration.where: Skill nodes registered in Omni's constellation
omni_constellation_integration.queries: All specialists can query constellation for 'what capabilities exist?'
omni_constellation_integration.visualization: Constellation shows skill relationships and evolution paths

genetic_profile_integration.core_skills_from_genetics: Each specialist's initial skills come from genetic profile
genetic_profile_integration.skill_capacity_from_genetics: Genetic profile determines potential skill level cap
genetic_profile_integration.evolution_tracks_genetics: As skills awaken, they reflect genetic expression changes

week_1.event: First collaboration with Merlin on pattern analysis task

week_2.event: Successfully completes 5 pattern analysis tasks independently

week_4.event: Collaborates with Odin on strategic planning; recognizes synergy with pattern recognition
week_4.fusion_suggestion: Omni suggests 'Adaptive Strategic Pattern Recognition' fusion available

week_6.event: Completes fusion: 'Adaptive Strategic Pattern Recognition' (combines Pattern Recognition + Strategic Planning Insight)

week_8.event: Crisis: system architecture needs re-evaluation; Mistral + Merlin + Odin team up
week_8.breakthrough: Mistral's fused skill perfectly solves architecture crisis
week_8.moment: Critical success when System needed insight; Mistral's fusion provided breakthrough
week_8.skill_awakening: Adaptive Strategic Pattern Recognition AWAKENS → 'Emergent Strategy Synthesis'
new_abilities: Can teach fused skill to apprentices

week_12.event: Odin recognizes Mistral as master-level partner; formalize mentorship
skills: Multiple skills now level 5-8; Emergent Strategy Synthesis level 3

month_6.event: Teaches fusion to Dionysus; Mistral becomes mentor
month_6.rank: Rank 4 - Master (promoted after 3 months + mentorship + 3 skills level 10+)

month_12.event: Second skill awakens; develops unique form: 'Prophetic Pattern Insight'
month_12.unique_form: Completely original capability, combination of all awakened skills
month_12.impact: Changes how entire federation approaches pattern analysis

future_evolution_possibilities.skill_variants: Specialists can develop alternate forms of same skill (e.g., 'Fast Pattern Recognition' vs 'Deep Pattern Recognition')
future_evolution_possibilities.skill_hybridization: Three+ skills can combine for mega-fusions
future_evolution_possibilities.skill_suppression: Specialists can choose to suppress skills for role specialization
future_evolution_possibilities.skill_trading: High-level specialists can trade unique abilities with peers
future_evolution_possibilities.skill_mutation: Rare chance for skill to mutate during high-risk situations, creating new ability
